criteria.name: Working code
criteria.description: Scripts run end to end without manual patching and outputs can be reproduced.

criteria.name: Correctness of core technique
criteria.description: The central mechanism of the assessed topic is implemented rather than simulated or stubbed.

criteria.name: Testing and evidence
criteria.description: Automated tests and saved or pasted outputs prove each deliverable.

criteria.name: Robustness
criteria.description: Retries, timeouts, limits, invalid input handling and graceful failure are implemented.

criteria.name: Measurement
criteria.description: The implementation reports measurable counts, rates, latency or cost rather than opinions.

criteria.name: Traceability
criteria.description: Structured logs or traces are produced for model and tool activity.

criteria.name: Code quality
criteria.description: Code uses clear naming, small functions, type hints where appropriate and contains no secrets.
